title: Notion pricing - Free through $18-30/member/month Business and Enterprise tiers
clean_text: Notion offers a Free plan with unlimited pages and core features, then Plus at $10/member/month (annual billing) which removes page-history and file-upload limits, Business at roughly $18-20/member/month (annual) with Notion AI bundled in as of early 2026, and Enterprise at a custom rate typically starting around $25-30/user/month for teams of 100+ seats, decreasing per-user at higher seat counts. Monthly (non-annual) billing is available at a higher per-seat rate, and annual billing typically discounts the monthly rate by up to ~20%.
